message: 乙女の舞いにてんてこ舞い

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, wait right there!」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! Pursuing any further is perilous!」

name: Misa
message: 「Because that girl isn't remorseful at all! Let go of me, Shio!」

name: Shio
message: 「To defy one's lord for their own benefit. I do this out of concern for your safety, Elder Sister!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Good grief, your bushido spirit really is a handful.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, that ain't bushido.」

name: Shio
message: 「Showed yourself, have you, foul spirit! I shall cut you down!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh no, stop it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy is just a talking panda, so he's harmless.」

name: Shio
message: 「I see. My apologies.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man... it's already too late for me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, are you and Shio-chan sisters, Misa? Japanese and Western--no matter how I look at it, you don't seem related by blood...」

name: Shio
message: 「Forgive my tardiness in introducing myself. I am Shio Asukai of Ryuusei Academy, Class 1-I. Though I am but a green youth, I humbly ask for your acquaintance.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's Class A, not Class \{I|\s12}.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura. Nice to meet you.」

name: Shio
message: 「I am already aware of you, Lord President.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm Nanaka! Nanaka Yuugiri!」

name: Shio
message: 「A pleasure to meet you for the first time, Lady Treasurer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, can't you do something about the way you address us?」

name: Shio
message: 「Then how would Synn-dono and Nanaka-dono fare?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what I meant...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio isn't my younger sister; she's my cousin.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「And why was Shio-chan fighting a Demon, then?」

name: Shio
message: 「Now that you have witnessed the scene, there is no helping it. Since ancient times, the Asukai family has made its living fighting spirits.」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat?! Shio, your family has been doing stuff like that?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Because it is a dangerous family trade, you were the one person I did not wish to find out, Elder Sister.」

name: Misa
message: 「This is the first I'm hearing of anything like that...」

name: Shio
message: 「I myself had no idea at all that you and the others had formed a band.」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess we're even on this matter, then.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ria-dono alone would be one thing, but to think even the members of the Student Council had thrown themselves into this battle.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know about Senpai!」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Ria-dono is a skilled spirit slayer. Her exploits on the battlefield are truly remarkable.」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet, though I psyched myself up thinking, 'This time, I shall be the one!', to expose such a blunder... How careless of me!」

name: Misa
message: 「You've got it wrong, Shio. What Senpai and we are doing isn't hunting youkai--our enemies are called Demons, which are... um, um...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun and Nanaka-san! What even are Demons in the first place?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I dunno!」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, umm, ummmmm, how should I explain this...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eek!」

name: Shio
message: 「Resolute and simple is close to benevolence. I too must further...」

name: Shio
message: 「I must train even harder!」

name: Misa
message: 「Training, training... So this is what you were training for...」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono. Next time, I shall surely pin down those spirits with my own hands.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, as I have club practice, I shall take my leave.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoaaa. Well, that sure blew me away.」

name: Synn
message: 「I never imagined there was someone else out there hunting Demons besides us.」

name: Misa
message: 「Seriously, Shio, keeping something this important a secret...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, it's not like she meant any harm by it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't she a sweet kid who cares about her big sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that look? You look like you're itching to say, 'Unlike a certain someone'」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a terrible misunderstanding! I was just thinking how nice it is to have sisters...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Hoping to deliciously devour a sister sandwich if the chance arises, truly--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Magyi!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, aren't you two pretty similar? Like how you both hate losing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Compared to Shio, I'm nothing.」
No, I think it's a pretty close match.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, the way she was going, there's no way she can beat a Demon all by herself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I hate to say it about Shio, but the Demon was treating her like a toy.」

name: Misa
message: 「A-A toy!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She was being played with however it pleased.」

name: Misa
message: 「H... How awful.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be great if she'd team up with us like she did earlier, though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She seems dead set on defeating them all on her own, no matter what.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa, do you think you could somehow talk her into it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't just leave her like this. There's no telling when she'll go through something awful again.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Fine. I'll try asking Shio to cooperate. It seems more reliable than just telling her not to do anything reckless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm strictly doing this for Shio's sake, okay.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, Shio-chan knew about Ria-senpai, didn't she?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. I thought they were just casual acquaintances, but judging from what we heard today, it seems there's some kind of close connection between them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's ask her after school or something.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mornin'~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai! Just what is your relationship with Shio-chan?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huuuh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Behind my back, what sort of vow have the two of you shared!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh-What's with you guys all of a sudden~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yada yada, so-and-so. And that's what happened.」

name: Ria
message: 「I~ see.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what's the real story here?」

name: Ria
message: 「'This family trade is the pride of the Asukai house, passed down through generations. Even if this one's strength falls short, I must continue to fight'」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Senpai...?」

name: Ria
message: 「'Hmph!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Even before I asked everyone for help, Shio-chan and I were each exterminating demons in our own different ways.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Different ways...?」

name: Ria
message: 「What Shio-chan calls mononoke--youkai--might actually be referring to demons.」

name: Synn
message: 「So they're the exact same beings.」

name: Ria
message: 「Probably, yeah. She... has strong spiritual sensitivity, so maybe she gets drawn to unnatural beings. She's happened to be at several demon exterminations before.」

name: Misa
message: 「Meaning Shio was drawn to the demon today as well.」

name: Ria
message: 「So, everyone. Did you see the way Shio-chan fought?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. That's something I'll never forget.」

name: Ria
message: 「Shio-chan can wield an extraordinary power--'qi'」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How utterly unrealistic...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bit late to be saying that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Unfortunately, though, that power has no effect on Demons...」

name: Synn
message: 「What.」

name: Ria
message: 「She always picks reckless fights, gets hurt, wears herself out, and in the end--」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demons just get bored of playing around and leave, ending the battle right there.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, that girl... Does she mistakenly think she actually defeated them...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Strictly speaking, she hasn't defeated them. Still, she does end up averting the immediate crisis.」

name: Synn
message: 「Every single time, she drags it into a war of attrition and fights a harsh, grueling battle.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yet she still believes in her own strength, trains diligently, and stands up to them.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds noble and all, but it's wasted effort.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-How pitiful...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't say that out loud.」
Riesling tumbled out of the driver's seat. Then, after checking her surroundings, she opened the back door as if nothing had happened.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fwaah... Good morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Lolo-chan. Morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Lolotte. You have a classmate named Shio Asukai, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Asukai, Asukai... Um,

name: Lolotte
message: Ah! The shrine maiden, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A shrine maiden?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio's family runs a shrine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aha, so that's how it ties into monster extermination.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're in different classes, but I'm sure we were together at the Naginata Club's trial session.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, really? Was she strong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She was by far the strongest among the freshmen. She was a dedicated hard worker, and everyone was saying she'd be the club's rising ace.」

name: Misa
message: 「You didn't stick with it, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, because the uniform and the naginata were too heavy.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, I see.」

name: Ria
message: 「Having a strong sense of justice is fine and all, but I really don't want her being too reckless.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case! How about we make her one of us!?」

name: Misa
message: 「No way! I can't let Shio get caught up in anything dangerous!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She doesn't seem to have any sense of danger whatsoever, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... There aren't any Rosaries left anymore... and without the power to fight...」
Actually, I think she was at least a little helpful in that last fight.
Does Shio not realize she has that extraordinary power?
